title: AnnounceScheduler RX-channel accessors use nonexistent state
description: python/src/lichen/announce/scheduler.py get_rx_channel()/set_rx_channel() read and write self.rx_channel, but the scheduler stores the signed rendezvous channel in config.rx_channel. get_rx_channel raises AttributeError and set_rx_channel does not affect built announces; it also silently maps invalid values to channel 0 instead of matching set_channel validation. Delegate these compatibility accessors to current_channel/set_channel and add regression tests.
